what: A `--cfg` in `.cargo/config.toml`'s `build.rustflags` re-keys the standard library: changing it rebuilt 147 units (`names core`, `link core` ..), about 5 s, where cargo applies rustflags to no prebuilt std. So compiletest's way of flipping a revision tests no reuse at all under blaze.
cost: the corpus importer was redesigned to set the cfg from a build script
cause: rustflags reach every unit, std's too
workaround: a generated `build.rs` that prints `cargo::rustc-cfg` from a file
state: open: is std meant to see the workspace's rustflags?
